Header.title: Track!!
Header.paragraph: Welcome to Carbon Conscious Tracker, where every step counts towards a greener tomorrow! Join us in minimizing your environmental impact and maximizing sustainability efforts.

About.paragraph: A Carbon Footprint Tracker, we're passionate about sustainability and environmental stewardship. Our mission is to empower individuals and organizations to make informed choices that reduce their carbon footprint and contribute to a healthier planet.

Services.name: History
Services.text: Explore your carbon emission history with us. We meticulously track and analyze your past carbon emissions, providing insights into your environmental impact.

Services.name: Flight
Services.text: Calculate the number of flights you take in a year and quantify the carbon emissions associated with each journey.

Services.name: Graph
Services.text: Visualize your progress towards a sustainable lifestyle with our interactive graphs. Track your carbon emissions, set goals, and monitor your impact on the environment over time.
